title: Synthetic City Belonging Admission Evidence Profile
status: research fixture profile; not a production reuse licence or complete HSDS profile
claim_ceiling: Defines local admission evidence and state enums for synthetic regression. It does not establish service truth, legal permission, safety, availability, or human outcomes.

evidence_contract.source_uri_format: URI string; synthetic fixtures use the synthetic:// scheme. This does not imply the source exists or grants reuse permission.
evidence_contract.timestamps: retrieved_at is required; provider_verified_at may be null. Non-null values must be RFC3339-like timestamps and are evaluated against policy_as_of_date.
evidence_contract.provider_verified_fields: Unique dot paths of resource.field. Each path must point to a field actually present in the same case's pinned HSDS resource row. Verification is field- and timestamp-scoped, never a blanket record trust label.

conflicts.purpose: Preserve competing claims and their lineage; do not resolve material conflicts by recency alone.

capacity_claim.purpose: A historical capacity value is not live availability without explicit authorized current evidence.

precedence: material conflict, failed contact, or unreviewed correction -> ReviewRequired
past event, stale schedule/capacity, or expired provider confirmation -> StaleOrDisputed
provider-supplied source + field-scoped current verification + active status -> ProviderConfirmed

display_claim_rules.current: Only ProviderConfirmed can be surfaced as current by this fixture policy.
display_claim_rules.map_pin: Requires location_type=physical and separate provider-confirmed latitude and longitude.

privacy_and_provenance: Do not infer loneliness, religion, trauma, or mental-health status.
Basic discovery must not require sensitive intake.
Public readability does not grant data reuse permission.
Fixture permission approved_for_fixture_only is test-only and grants no real data rights.
freshness_policy_reference: The fixture manifest pins policy_as_of_date and provider_confirmation_max_age_days. The threshold is an illustrative policy parameter, not a universal standard.
